name: Client Certificate Details
description: Client Certificate Details Get Details for a single mTLS API Shield Client Certificate. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates/{client_certificate_id}

name: Create Client Certificate
description: Create Client Certificate Create a new API Shield mTLS Client Certificate. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates
Create a new API Shield mTLS Client Certificate.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Revoke Client Certificate
description: Revoke Client Certificate Set a API Shield mTLS Client Certificate to pending_revocation status for processing to revoked status. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates/{client_certificate_id}

name: Reactivate Client Certificate
description: Reactivate Client Certificate If a API Shield mTLS Client Certificate is in a pending_revocation state, you may reactivate it with this endpoint. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates/{client_certificate_id}

name: List Client Certificates
description: List Client Certificates List all of your Zone's API Shield mTLS Client Certificates by Status and/or using Pagination. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/client_certificates
List all of your Zone's API Shield mTLS Client Certificates by Status and/or using Pagination.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: status (query); page (query); per_page (query); limit (query); offset (query)
